plugins.name: harvard-negotiation-coach
plugins.description: Helps you get through a tough conversation: asking for a raise, agreeing on a price or contract, a disagreement with a colleague, a family dispute. Analyzes the situation, helps you prepare, suggests what to say when you're under pressure, and lets you rehearse. Based on the book Getting to Yes.

plugins.name: test-automation-coach
plugins.description: Explains test automation in plain words, helps decide whether automating is worth it, plans automation and QA processes from scratch, and reviews or writes autotests without over-engineering. Based on the book Let's automate it!
